rules.hypothesis: Prior-session 70% volume value-area re-entry toward opposite edge
rules.volumeApproximation: Uniform volume over each minute low-high; sensitivity places volume at (H+L+C)/3
rules.profile: Completed previous regular session only; 400 equal-price bins; contiguous 70% from POC
rules.ties: Lowest-price POC; expand down first for equal adjacent volumes
rules.acceptance: Open strictly outside prior VA; consecutive closes strictly inside; first acceptance only
rules.entry: Next observed bar open; skip final-bar entries or opens at/beyond stop or target; max one trade/day
rules.stop: Beyond entry-side VA boundary by 10% of previous-session full high-low range
rules.target: Opposite prior-session VA boundary; limit gaps receive target, stops gap at adverse open
rules.ambiguity: Stop first when same minute touches both; final observed bar open liquidation precedes its range
rules.sizing: Fractional 1x starting-equity notional per trade, no leverage/overnight; short quantity uses entry proceeds basis
rules.costs: Adverse entry/exit fills by 0/1/5/10 bps each side; no extra commission
rules.netR: Net price P&L divided by absolute adverse-entry-fill to original stop distance
rules.drawdown: Realized session-close sampled equity, excludes intraday unrealized drawdown
rules.baseline: Same accepted entries and direction, exit final bar open without stop/target
rules.targetTouchedByEod: Diagnostic ignores stops: target touched from actual entry through penultimate bar range or final bar OPEN; denominator all accepted trades
rules.variants: Five predeclared one-at-a-time sensitivities; no winner selected

warnings: Minute OHLCV cannot recover true traded volume at each price; profiles are approximations.
Stop buffer, acceptance count, binning and exits are explicit research choices, not fully specified by the video.
Both chronological windows have been explored in earlier QQQ research; evaluation is not a pristine holdout.
Vendor-adjusted research data are not point-in-time account reconstruction; no dividend cash/share transformations.
No historical spread, order book, queue, latency, impact, fees beyond stated bps, taxes, cash yield, borrow availability/cost or financing.
Fractional unlevered notional model is not the production broker simulator or a claim of executable fills.
Baseline conditions on strategy entry eligibility; it is not buy-and-hold or a randomized control.
Profit factor is null when no losing trades exist; empty-trade means and rates are null.
